# widget-icons

This package includes the icon set as plain SVG files, a JavaScript module of SVG strings, an icon font and an SVG sprite, so it fits projects with or without a bundler.

## Installation

```
npm install widget-icons
```

## Why widget-icons?

Use it when you need icon fonts, sprites or plain SVG files. Bundled apps should import single icons from the main package instead, so unused icons are left out of the build and the page stays fast.
